page.layout: One page of verse, single column. Ornamental border above the heading. Heading in capitals with a subtitle, then a verse dedication in italic stanzas with a woodcut initial H. No running head, no margin notes. Catchword "Illumque" at the lower right.

l.i: regibus Te nostra gestit dicere nunc Lyra,
Nunc hoste caso Gallia te suum
Ausa suo est dare iura Regi!

page.notes: The woodcut initial H is joined to the word "ENRICE" as HENRICE. The printed word "ciuicis" is read as civicis, and "iuuentus" as iuventus, following the u/v rule. "Inuisa" is read as Invisa. "Bellísque" has an acute accent as printed. The word "caso" is printed "cafo" in the long-s form and is copied as caso. Faint show-through from the reverse page on the right margin was left out. Verse lines are run together within each stanza, since the printed line breaks are not marked as line elements here.
